परि-√ यज् P. -यजति (aor. 2. sg. पर्य्-अ॑यास्), to obtain or procure by sacrificing, RV. ix, 82, 5;
to sacrifice or worship before or after another, to perform a secondary or accompanying rite, Br.; ŚrS.
a secondary or accompanying rite (which precedes or follows another in any ritual), KātyŚr.
constituting a secondary rite, ib.
a younger brother performing a Soma sacrifice antecedently to the elder, Āpast. (v.l.)
परि-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to surround, beset, TāṇḍBr.
surrounded, beset, hemmed in RV.; TS.; AitBr.
come near, arrived from (abl.), R.
one who has travelled about, Hcat.

परि-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to aim, hit, RV. :
Caus. -यमयति, to serve, assist, Sāy.
one who has gone through or studied, completely familiar with (comp.), Hcat.
See under 1. पार.
going about &c., Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29 (cf. पर्याण).
See अ-परियाणि.
a travelling carriage, Gal.
mfn., Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29.
परि-√ 2. यु Desid. -युयूषति, to strive to span or embrace, RV. vi, 62, 1.
clasping, embracing, Nir. ii, 8.
= पलि-य्˚, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 22,
Vārtt. 1
pl. N. of a school, L.
पारि—यात्र m. (ifc. f(आ). ) N. of the western Vindhya range, MBh.; Var.; Suśr. &c. (also -क, L.)
N. of a man (son of Ahīna-gu), Ragh.; Pur.
पारि—या˚त्रिक m. an inhabitant of the P˚ range, Var.
पारि—यानिक n. (-यान) a travelling carriage, L.
